source: GitHub user asymetryk (type User, public_repos 10). Listed with `gh repo list asymetryk --limit 1000` and checked against `gh api --paginate users/asymetryk/repos?per_page=100&type=owner`. Includes the four public forks (buzz, cmux, kept, openproject) because they are repos this account has. Private repos were not visible: GET /user returned 403 for this credential, and `gh repo list` with no owner only saw asymetryk/mirmicode. Refresh by replacing `repos` from those commands. The browser never calls GitHub; the map merges this file at load.
